Select a separate diagnostic envelope with energy ceiling 34 units: initial J^2/(2m)=32, plus all 14.15 dynamic mass units times configured gravity 9.81 and a maximum centre-of-mass drop of 0.01125 game units below each at-rest reference height at any point in the complete trial (1.561629375), rounded upward by 0.438370625. The probe must enforce this global displacement bound from conservative full-substep sweeps and reject before any step whose swept COM could exceed it.

Use cylinder minimum inertias from configured dimensions/masses and farthest collider radii; at E=34 derive full-precision sweep and rotation limits for each body. Freeze maxTranslationPerSubstep=0.01125, maxRotationPerSubstep=pi/8 and maxSubstepsPerTick=48 only if the derivation yields Nrequired<=48 for all 15 bodies; otherwise stop and recompute the entire envelope.

Freeze a 325-unit invisible open support apron from every painted edge, no walls. Enforce swept full-collider horizontal containment. The vertical fallback is a global 0.01125-COM-drop bound relative to each body's initial rest height, not a continuous-floor-contact claim; the 0.20 support slab plus per-call swept collider bound prevents passing through it. Include that bounded potential drop in E and fail closed on an unprovable sweep or larger drop.

Before the impulse, inspect the actual pinned Havok material values for the surface and every dynamic shape; require finite nonnegative friction and restitution in [0,1], and require actual masses/inertias no less conservative than the derived bounds. Define workload units explicitly: at most 15 seconds/1,800 nominal 120-Hz ticks, 86,400 actual public Havok executeStep calls total, at most 120 actual calls between host yields, and at most 30,000 ms wall time. Exhaustion is resourceLimit with no partial success; these limits do not assert the trial will fit the wall budget.

Keep frame/fact limits at the accepted protocol limits, preserve open green pavement/crossing planes, label the envelope diagnostic-only, and specify config schema/hash versioning plus the requirement to update every config-hash fixture.
